stories.title: NIKKE PC game launcher hacked to spread remote access, data-stealing malware
stories.summary: The developers of Goddess of Victory: NIKKE have confirmed that hackers tampered with the game's PC launcher scripts in a supply-chain attack, distributing malware capable of stealing credentials and cryptocurrency wallet data.

US midterm results unsettle French far right, boost hopes left ahead of presidential election
stories.summary: The French left and the centrist bloc have analyzed the defeat of Donald Trump's party in light of France's upcoming elections, seeing it as a source of hope, while the far right is increasingly distancing itself from its 'lame duck' American counterpart.

stories.title: Voters in Washington, DC, decide to ban sale of foie gras
stories.summary: A referendum on banning foie gras in Washington, DC, won 73% of the vote on Tuesday.

stories.title: European leaders welcome Democrats' US midterms election win
stories.summary: European leaders voiced hopes for a reset with the United States on Wednesday, November 4, after voters delivered a huge midterm election defeat to President Donald Trump and his Republican party. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating has more.

stories.title: Shock Wednesday in Paris: Hijikata stuns Djokovic as Zverev, Medvedev, De Minaur and Tiafoe also fall
stories.summary: Qualifier Rinky Hijikata, ranked 83rd, came from a set down to beat seven-time champion Novak Djokovic 2-6, 6-3, 6-3 in the second round of the Rolex Paris Masters, on a day that also saw Zverev, Medvedev, De Minaur and Tiafoe fall.

stories.title: Defeat ends Djokovic's hopes of making ATP Finals
stories.summary: Novak Djokovic is out of the race to qualify for the ATP Finals in Turin after a second-round defeat by qualifier Rinky Hijikata at the Paris Masters.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
